card.name: Just before the word outpatient
card.fires_on: Small linking words (as, an, or, in, for) and "Amb" right before an expected "outpatient" or "ambulatory", usually in contrast with inpatient or hospital care.

modes.label: Linking word before outpatient
modes.description: A word like as, an, or, or in that sits just ahead of "outpatient" after inpatient or hospital is mentioned.
